mapper.select: SELECT pmj.*, (SELECT unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fn WHERE fn.unit_id = fe.unit_id) as unit_name, (SELECT position_name FROM fnd_org_position fop WHERE fop.position_id = fe.position_id) as position_name, (SELECT company_short_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = fe.company_id) as company_short_name, (SELECT employee_code FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as employee_code, (SELECT name FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as name, fe.POSITION_ID, fe.UNIT_ID, sua.user_id as approver_user_id FROM prj_meeting_judge pmj, fnd_employee_assigns fe, sys_user_allocation sua where sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id and pmj.judge_user_allocation_id = sua.allocation_id

select ppma.vote_result, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'PRJ325.VOTE_RESULT' AND ppma.vote_result = v.code_value) vote_result_n, count(ppma.vote_result) result_count, ppma.project_id, ppma.approval_id from prj_project_meeting_approver ppma group by ppma.vote_result,ppma.project_id,ppma.approval_id having ppma.project_id = #{projectId} and ppma.approval_id = #{approvalId} and ppma.vote_result is not null
mapper.update: UPDATE prj_project_meeting_approver ppma SET ppma.director_flag = #{directorFlag} WHERE ppma.approval_id = #{approvalId} and ppma.APPROVER_USER_ID = #{approverUserId}
